zh: 新世界建議1供11供股集資249億
周大福企業滙豐星展全額包銷
work.en: New World Development proposed a 1-for-11 rights issue to raise HK$249 billion at HK$0.90 per share, representing an 81.5% discount to its last closing price. The issue is fully underwritten by Chow Tai Fook Enterprises, HSBC, and DBS. Net proceeds will be used for loan refinancing, debt settlement, and project funding.
work.title: 新世界發展建議按「1供11」方式 供股集資249億元

work.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan noted that dim sum bonds accounted for 38% of Hong Kong's listed bond issuances in the first three quarters, surpassing US dollar bonds for the first time. HKEX is launching its first-ever bond index, the Offshore RMB Bond Index, covering over 300 listed bonds to serve as a market benchmark.

work.en: Federal Reserve official Mary Daly warned that worsening inflation may force further interest rate hikes, driving 10-year US Treasury yields up by 1.4 basis points. In response to rising rate expectations, Hong Kong banks are intensifying deposit competition, with OCBC offering 1-month HKD fixed deposit rates up to 5.5%.
